name: EPIC 205007777
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 10.1 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205007777 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.138024 (16th-84th percentiles 9.981707-10.364656), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,715 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.85 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,756 K at its surface.
